items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: He used to go back there and help him to cut the grass back there, you know, sometimes, I had time.

ctx.x: You're supposed to hit him with, roll up the newspaper and get him with it.

No, no, I'm dog-hawty. He's too cute. Kilmer got a dog that tore his yard up so bad, he looked like a hog pet back there, man. You go back by Kilmer's house, man, done tore up all the grass and everything. And then he got all puddles of water, all the ground, all tore up. He had it nice back there. He used to go back there and help him to cut the grass back there, you know, sometimes, I had time. He had a dog that tore the whole yard up. All the rose bushes, beautiful rose bushes, American beauty roses. He done…
But he doesn't get beat up.
